description.p: AmpMod is a block-based programming language built off TurboWarp that adds many small but meaningful features to Scratch to make it even better, such as first-class lists, case sensitivity, and custom extensions.
description.h2: Build a game easily with block-based programming!
description.p: With AmpMod, you can create games, animations, art, and more quickly by dragging blocks instead of manually typing everything out.

ul.li: AmpMod compiles projects to JavaScript to make them run faster than in vanilla Scratch.
With arrays, you can create complex list structures and store them as variables.
To make AmpMod more powerful, dozens of new unsandboxed extensions are added.
AmpMod features new fonts like Comic and Amplification to use in your costumes and backdrops.
Creating a rounded rectangle has never been easier with the Rounded Rectangle tool.
Custom fonts can be loaded from system font name or a font file.
